q1.q: Does the AI make up prices and times?
q1.a: No. Prices, opening hours and available slots come only from information you approve. The system checks booking rules and forwards unanswered questions to staff.

q2.q: Which channels does it work on?
q2.a: We start with Telegram. WhatsApp and Instagram connect after official approval. WhatsApp message fees follow Meta's rates, are billed separately and are shown to you in advance.

q3.q: How is my customers' data protected?
q3.a: Customer records, conversations and reports belong to each business workspace and are separated from other businesses.

q4.a: Request a demo and we review your services and hours, then show a sample conversation on Telegram. No paid service starts without your approval.

q5.q: When does a manager step in?
q5.a: When the AI is unsure, and for complaints and discount questions. The manager gets a notification and continues the chat.
